* **YouTube - Hide ads:** Prevent unintended navigation button swap ([#2659](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/issues/2659)) ([389d2d3](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/389d2d37ddd14dd102ce98bafa85feedb1df8234))

* **YouTube - Hide layout components:** Add "Hide 'Top fans' button" setting ([#2660](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/issues/2660)) ([1e719f6](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/1e719f614c75163bda9b9bac95bbadfb6268ff1c))
* **YouTube - Hide layout components:** Add "Hide filter bar in channel page" and "Hide 'Members only' chip" settings ([#2622](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/issues/2622)) ([5db5a77](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/5db5a7799d3617b4d93d39ecc42c3d0af58308e8))
* **YouTube - Hide player flyout menu components:** Add "Hide 'On-the-go' menu" setting ([#2715](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/issues/2715)) ([8408ec9](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/8408ec93703286988fe1b65024cea272e19aa489))
* **YouTube - Save to Watch later:** Support for related kids videos ([#2572](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/issues/2572)) ([b0ec540](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/b0ec540b8829864e3fdcda5910edff1fddf1a72a))
* **YouTube - Wide search bar:** Replace the toggle with Disabled, Wide and Extra wide options ([#2608](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/issues/2608)) ([ce18f82](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/ce18f821225e7c82da6832828e405d56394026fe))
* **YouTube Music - Hide music action buttons:** Add "Hide 'Live chat replay' button" setting ([#2674](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/issues/2674)) ([d43da80](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/d43da80e8b27a5e767337d3a4c2fec64bb221d59))

### 🔧 Improvements

patches.name: App refresh rate
patches.description: Adds an option to change the app refresh rate.

patches.name: Bypass certificate checks
patches.description: Bypasses certificate checks which prevent YouTube Music from working on Android Auto.

patches.name: Change header
patches.description: Adds an option to change the header logo in the top left corner of the app.

options.description:
Folder with images to use as a custom header logo.

            The folder must contain one or more of the following folders, depending on the DPI of the device:
            - drawable-hdpi
- drawable-xhdpi
- drawable-xxhdpi
- drawable-xxxhdpi

            Each of the folders must contain the following file(s):
            - morphe_header_custom_dark.png

            Required dimensions:
            - drawable-hdpi: 121x36 px
- drawable-xhdpi: 160x48 px
- drawable-xxhdpi: 240x72 px
- drawable-xxxhdpi: 320x96 px

patches.name: Change miniplayer color
patches.description: Adds an option to change the miniplayer background color to match the fullscreen player.

patches.name: Change start page
patches.description: Adds an option to set which page the app opens in instead of the homepage.

patches.name: Check watch history domain name resolution
patches.description: Checks if the device DNS server is preventing user watch history from being saved.

patches.name: Crossfade
patches.description: Adds a true dual-player crossfade between consecutive tracks. Requires YouTube Music 9.00 or newer; on older versions the patch is a no-op.

patches.name: Custom branding
patches.description: Adds options to change the app icon and app name. Branding cannot be changed for mounted (root) installations.

options.description:
Folder with images to use as a custom icon.
            
            The folder must contain one or more of the following folders, depending on the DPI of the device:
            - mipmap-mdpi
- mipmap-hdpi
- mipmap-xhdpi
- mipmap-xxhdpi
- mipmap-xxxhdpi
            
            Each of the folders must contain all of the following files:
            morphe_adaptive_background_custom.png
morphe_adaptive_foreground_custom.png
            
            The image dimensions must be as follows:
            - mipmap-mdpi: 108x108 px
- mipmap-hdpi: 162x162 px
- mipmap-xhdpi: 216x216 px
- mipmap-xxhdpi: 324x324 px
- mipmap-xxxhdpi: 432x432 px

            Optionally, the path contains a 'drawable' folder with a monochrome icon file:
            morphe_adaptive_monochrome_custom.xml

            Optionally, the path contains a notification icon in one of the following formats:
            - XML vector drawable placed in 'drawable':
              morphe_notification_icon_custom.xml
            - PNG raster images placed in the matching 'drawable-<dpi>' folders:
              - drawable-mdpi/morphe_notification_icon_custom.png (24x24 px)
- drawable-hdpi/morphe_notification_icon_custom.png (36x36 px)
- drawable-xhdpi/morphe_notification_icon_custom.png (48x48 px)
- drawable-xxhdpi/morphe_notification_icon_custom.png (72x72 px)
- drawable-xxxhdpi/morphe_notification_icon_custom.png (96x96 px)

patches.name: Disable dislike redirection
patches.description: Adds an option to prevent skipping to the next track when the dislike button is pressed.

patches.name: Disable DRC audio
patches.description: Adds an option to disable DRC (Dynamic Range Compression) audio.

patches.name: Disable QUIC protocol
patches.description: Adds an option to disable QUIC (Quick UDP Internet Connections) network protocol.

patches.name: Downloads
patches.description: Adds support to download songs with an external downloader app using the in-app download button.

patches.name: Enable debugging
patches.description: Adds options for debugging and exporting Morphe logs to the clipboard.

patches.name: Enable exclusive audio playback
patches.description: Enables the option to play audio without video.

patches.name: Enable forced miniplayer
patches.description: Adds an option to enable forced miniplayer when switching between music videos, podcasts, or songs.

patches.name: Enable swipe to dismiss miniplayer
patches.description: Adds an option to enable dismissing the miniplayer by swiping down on it.

patches.name: Force original audio
patches.description: Adds an option to always use the original audio track.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Allows the app to work without root by using a different package name when patched using a GmsCore instead of Google Play Services.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Adds options to hide fullscreen ads, Premium promotions and video ads.

patches.name: Hide buttons
patches.description: Adds options to hide the cast, history, notification, and search buttons.

patches.name: Hide filter bar
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the filter bar at the top of the homepage.

patches.name: Hide flyout menu components
patches.description: Adds options to hide individual items from the player and queue flyout menus.

patches.name: Hide layout components
patches.description: Adds options to hide general layout components.

patches.name: Hide music action buttons
patches.description: Adds options to hide action buttons under the player.

patches.name: Miniplayer previous and next buttons
patches.description: Adds options to show previous and next track buttons in the miniplayer.

patches.name: Navigation bar
patches.description: Adds options to hide navigation bar, labels and buttons.

patches.name: Network proxy
patches.description: Adds settings to route supported network requests through an HTTP or HTTPS proxy.

patches.name: Play albums songs
patches.description: Adds an option to play the song version of album tracks instead of music videos.

patches.name: PoToken provider
patches.description: Adds option to get PoToken using an external PoToken minter app.

patches.name: Remember repeat state
patches.description: Adds an option to remember the repeat state when playing a new track or playlist.

patches.name: Remember shuffle state
patches.description: Adds an option to remember the shuffle state when playing a new track or playlist.

patches.name: Remove background playback restrictions
patches.description: Removes restrictions on background playback, including playing kids videos in the background.

patches.name: Remove viewer discretion dialog
patches.description: Adds an option to remove the dialog that appears when opening a video that has been age-restricted by accepting it automatically. This does not bypass the age restriction.

patches.name: Return YouTube Dislike
patches.description: Adds an option to show the dislike count of tracks with Return YouTube Dislike.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

patches.name: Scrobbling
patches.description: Adds options to add played tracks to Last.fm and ListenBrainz.

patches.name: Settings menu filter
patches.description: Adds an option to hide items on the standard YouTube Music settings screen by their visible name.

patches.name: SponsorBlock
patches.description: Adds options to enable and configure SponsorBlock, which can skip non-music segments.

patches.name: Spoof app version
patches.description: Adds an option to trick the app into thinking you are running an older version.

patches.name: Spoof video streams
patches.description: Adds options to spoof the client video streams to fix playback.

patches.name: Theme
patches.description: Adds options for theming, and settings to change the app foreground and background colors.

options.description: Can be a hex color (#RRGGBB) or a color resource reference. Setting a color of either theme applies both while patching and removes the in-app theme color settings.

patches.name: Third-party lyrics
patches.description: Adds an option to show synced lyrics from LRCLIB or KuGou in the lyrics panel.

patches.name: Add to queue
patches.description: Overrides the feed flyout 'Play next in queue' with the Morphe video queue.

patches.name: Alternative thumbnails
patches.description: Adds options to replace video thumbnails using the DeArrow API or image captures from the video.

patches.name: Ambient mode
patches.description: Adds options to bypass power saving restrictions for Ambient mode and disable it entirely or in fullscreen.

patches.name: App refresh rate
patches.description: Adds an option to change the app refresh rate.

patches.name: Bypass image region restrictions
patches.description: Adds an option to use a different host for user avatar and channel images and can fix missing images that are blocked in some countries.

patches.name: Bypass link redirects
patches.description: Adds an option to bypass redirects and open the original link directly.

patches.name: Captions
patches.description: Adds an option to disable captions from being automatically enabled or to set caption cookies.

patches.name: Change form factor
patches.description: Adds an option to change the UI appearance to a phone, tablet, or automotive device.

patches.name: Custom player overlay opacity

patches.name: Disable double tap actions

patches.name: Disable DRC audio
patches.description: Adds an option to disable DRC (Dynamic Range Compression) audio.

patches.name: Disable fullscreen gestures
patches.description: Adds options to selectively disable gestures for entering and exiting fullscreen mode, and to disable pinch-to-zoom.

patches.name: Disable haptic feedback
patches.description: Adds an option to disable haptic feedback in the player for various actions.

patches.name: Disable layout updates
patches.description: Adds an option to disable server side layout updates and use an older UI.

patches.name: Disable QUIC protocol

patches.name: Disable scrolling speed limit

patches.name: Disable Shorts resuming on startup

patches.name: Disable sign in to TV popup

patches.name: Disable video codecs

patches.name: Double tap to seek

patches.name: Downloads

patches.name: Enable debugging
patches.description: Adds options for debugging and exporting Morphe logs to the clipboard.

patches.name: Exit fullscreen mode

patches.name: Force original audio
patches.description: Adds an option to always use the original audio track.

patches.name: Fullscreen video scale
patches.description: Adds options to stretch or zoom videos to fill the screen in fullscreen mode.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Allows the app to work without root by using a different package name when patched using a GmsCore instead of Google Play Services.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Adds options to hide general ads, Premium promotions and video ads.

patches.name: Hide autoplay preview
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the autoplay preview at the end of videos.

patches.name: Hide end screen cards
patches.description: Adds an option to hide suggested video cards at the end of videos.

patches.name: Hide end screen suggested video
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the suggested video at the end of videos.

patches.name: Hide info cards
patches.description: Adds an option to hide info cards that creators add in the video player.

patches.name: Hide layout components
patches.description: Adds options to hide general layout components.

patches.name: Hide player flyout menu components
patches.description: Adds options to hide menu components that appear when pressing the gear icon in the video player.

patches.name: Hide player overlay buttons
patches.description: Adds options to hide the player Cast, Autoplay, Captions, Previous & Next buttons, and the player control buttons background.

patches.name: Hide related video overlay
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the related video overlay shown when swiping up in fullscreen.

patches.name: Hide related videos
patches.description: Adds options to hide related videos.

patches.name: Hide Shorts components
patches.description: Adds options to hide components related to Shorts.

options.description: Permanently hides the shortcut to open Shorts when long pressing the app icon in your launcher.
Permanently hides the launcher widget Shorts button.

patches.name: Hide timestamp
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the timestamp in the bottom left of the video player.

patches.name: Hide video action buttons
patches.description: Adds options to hide video action buttons in fullscreen and portrait modes.

patches.name: Loop video
patches.description: Adds an option to loop videos and display loop video button in the video player.

patches.name: Media notification controls
patches.description: Adds options to disable the seekbar and previous/next buttons in the media notification and headphone controls.

patches.name: Miniplayer
patches.description: Adds options to change the in-app minimized player. Patching 21.28.206 and lower has more miniplayer types to choose from.

patches.name: Mute button
patches.description: Adds an option to show a player button that mutes the video audio.

patches.name: Navigation bar
patches.description: Adds options to hide and change the bottom navigation bar (such as the Shorts button)  and the upper navigation toolbar.

patches.name: Network proxy
patches.description: Adds settings to route supported network requests through an HTTP or HTTPS proxy.

patches.name: Open channel of live avatar
patches.description: Adds an option to prevent a channel's current live video from opening when tapping its avatar.

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app browser.

patches.name: Open Shorts in regular player
patches.description: Adds options to open Shorts in the regular video player.

patches.name: Open system share sheet
patches.description: Adds an option to always open the system share sheet instead of the in-app share sheet.

patches.name: Open videos fullscreen
patches.description: Adds options to automatically open videos in fullscreen portrait or landscape mode.

patches.name: Override YouTube Music buttons
patches.description: Overrides YouTube Music buttons to open Morphe Music or any compatible third-party client.

patches.name: Play all
patches.description: Adds an option to play all the videos from a channel and to display play all button in the video player.

patches.name: Playback in feeds
patches.description: Adds the 'Playback in feeds' setting of YouTube to the Morphe settings, where it is always available even if YouTube hides it.

patches.name: Playback speed
patches.description: Adds options to customize available playback speeds, set a default playback speed, and show a speed dialog button in the video player.

patches.name: PoToken provider
patches.description: Adds option to get PoToken using an external PoToken minter app.

patches.name: Reload video
patches.description: Adds an option to display reload video button in the video player.

patches.name: Remove background playback restrictions
patches.description: Removes restrictions on background playback, including playing kids videos in the background.

patches.name: Remove viewer discretion dialog
patches.description: Adds an option to remove the dialog that appears when opening a video that has been age-restricted by accepting it automatically. This does not bypass the age restriction.

patches.name: Return YouTube Dislike
patches.description: Adds an option to show the dislike count of videos with Return YouTube Dislike.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

patches.name: Save to Watch later
patches.description: Adds an option to display save to Watch later button in the video player.

patches.name: Seekbar
patches.description: Adds options to show old seekbar thumbnails, disable precise seeking when swiping up on the seekbar, slide to seek instead of playing at 2x speed when pressing and holding, tapping the player seekbar to seek, hiding the video player seekbar, enabling seeking in livestreams, and expanding the livestream DVR duration.

patches.name: Settings menu filter
patches.description: Adds an option to hide items on the standard YouTube settings screen by their visible name.

patches.name: Shorts autoplay
patches.description: Adds options to automatically play the next Short.

patches.name: SponsorBlock
patches.description: Adds options to enable and configure SponsorBlock, which can skip undesired video segments such as sponsored content.

patches.name: Spoof app version
patches.description: Adds an option to trick the app into thinking you are running an older version.

patches.name: Spoof device dimensions
patches.description: Adds an option to spoof the device dimensions which can unlock higher video qualities.

patches.name: Spoof video streams
patches.description: Adds options to spoof the client video streams to fix playback.

patches.name: Swipe controls
patches.description: Adds options to enable and configure volume and brightness swipe controls.

patches.name: Theme
patches.description: Adds options for theming, and settings to change the app foreground and background colors.

options.description: Can be a hex color (#RRGGBB) or a color resource reference. Setting a color of either theme applies both while patching and removes the in-app theme color settings.
Can be a hex color (#RRGGBB) or a color resource reference. Setting a color of either theme applies both while patching and removes the in-app theme color settings.

patches.name: Video quality
patches.description: Adds options to set default video qualities and always use the advanced video quality menu.

patches.name: Voice over translation
patches.description: Adds additional voice over languages using text-to-speech synchronized to the video playback.

patches.name: Wide search bar
patches.description: Adds a wide search bar to the top of the home and subscription feed.

patches.name: Custom branding name for Reddit
patches.description: Changes the Reddit app name to the name specified in patch options.

patches.name: Custom font
patches.description: Adds an option to replace Reddit Sans / Roboto with a custom TTF or OTF font file at runtime.

patches.name: Disable modern home
patches.description: Adds an option to disable the modern home UI. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and earlier.

patches.name: Disable screenshot popup
patches.description: Adds an option to disable the popup that appears when taking a screenshot.

patches.name: Force system font
patches.description: Adds an option that renders Reddit with the device system font instead of Reddit Sans / Roboto.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Adds options to hide ads.

patches.name: Hide Ask button
patches.description: Adds an option to hide Ask button in the search bar.

patches.name: Hide communities shelf
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the related or suggested communities shelf in subreddits.

patches.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches.description: Adds options to hide buttons in the navigation bar.

patches.name: Hide Reddit search
patches.description: Permanently hides the Reddit search in the contextual menu. This patch does not work with root mounting

patches.name: Hide sidebar components
patches.description: Adds options to hide the sidebar components.

patches.name: Hide Trending shelves
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the Trending shelves from feed and search suggestions.

patches.name: Open links directly
patches.description: Adds an option to skip over redirection URLs in external links.

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app-browser.

patches.name: Remove subreddit dialog
patches.description: Adds options to remove the NSFW community warning and notifications suggestion dialogs by dismissing them automatically.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Adds an option to sanitize sharing links by removing tracking query parameters.

patches.name: Show view count
patches.description: Adds an option to show the view count of Posts.

patches.name: Spoof signature
patches.description: Spoofs the signature of the app to fix notification issues.
